clues.it: Giada era nella 2ª colonna, nella 1ª riga e a nord di Anna.
clues.en: Giada was in the 2nd column, in the 1st row and north of Anna.

clues.it: Nino era nella 4ª colonna, accanto a un cappotto caduto e nella stessa stanza di Giada.
clues.en: Nino was in the 4th column, beside a dropped coat and in the same room as Giada.

clues.it: Luca era nella 11ª colonna, nella 3ª riga e a nord di Sergio.
clues.en: Luca was in the 11th column, in the 3rd row and north of Sergio.

clues.it: LA VITTIMA. Era da sola con l'assassino.
clues.en: The Victim. Was alone with the murderer.

clues.it: Paolo era nella 5ª riga e nella Hall, ma non era accanto a dei bicchieri rotti.
clues.en: Paolo was in the 5th row and in the Lobby, but was not beside broken glasses.

clues.it: Sergio era nella 6ª riga, a nord di Irene e nella Sala da Ballo.
clues.en: Sergio was in the 6th row, north of Irene and in the Ballroom.

clues.it: Fabio era a ovest di Olga e nella Sala da Ballo.
clues.en: Fabio was west of Olga and in the Ballroom.

clues.it: Dario era nella 7ª colonna, a ovest di Luca e nella Suite Reale.
clues.en: Dario was in the 7th column, west of Luca and in the Royal Suite.

clues.it: Ugo era nella 9ª riga e accanto a una palma in vaso, ma non era accanto a un tavolo da biliardo.
clues.en: Ugo was in the 9th row and beside a potted palm, but was not beside a billiard table.

clues.it: Olga era in una stanza diversa da Giada e nella Suite Reale.
clues.en: Olga was in a different room from Giada and in the Royal Suite.

clues.it: Irene era accanto a dei bicchieri rotti e in una stanza diversa da Sergio, ma non era accanto a il bancone della reception.
clues.en: Irene was beside broken glasses and in a different room from Sergio, but was not beside the reception desk.

general_clues.en: 5 in the west half of the grid.
5 in the north half of the grid.

1 accanto a un baule da viaggio.

steps.it: L'indizio di Giada lascia una sola casella libera: riga 1ª, colonna 2ª.
steps.en: Giada's own clue leaves a single free square: row 1st, column 2nd.

steps.it: L'indizio di Nino lascia una sola casella libera: riga 2ª, colonna 4ª.
steps.en: Nino's own clue leaves a single free square: row 2nd, column 4th.

steps.en: Luca's own clue leaves a single free square: row 3rd, column 11th.

steps.it: L'indizio di Paolo lascia una sola casella libera: riga 5ª, colonna 1ª.
steps.en: Paolo's own clue leaves a single free square: row 5th, column 1st.

steps.it: L'indizio di Ugo lascia una sola casella libera: riga 9ª, colonna 5ª.
steps.en: Ugo's own clue leaves a single free square: row 9th, column 5th.

steps.it: Ugo può stare solo nella 9ª riga: escludendola, a Irene resta una sola casella: riga 11ª, colonna 8ª.
steps.en: Ugo can only be in the 9th row: ruling it out leaves Irene a single square: row 11th, column 8th.

steps.en: Ugo can only be in the 5th column: ruling it out leaves Sergio a single square: row 6th, column 3rd.

steps.en: Irene can only be in the 11th row: ruling it out leaves Dario a single square: row 8th, column 7th.

steps.it: Nessun altro può stare nella 10ª riga, e lì a Olga resta una sola casella libera: la 9ª colonna.
steps.en: No one else can be in the 10th row, and it leaves Olga a single free square there: the 9th column.
